subject: Cat Trivia
overview: Contestants competed in the premiere episode of Trivia On Air, answering trivia questions focused on cats across two rounds.

items.title: Introduction and Contestant Welcome
items.summary: Contestants were introduced for the first episode of the trivia competition.

items.title: Cat Trivia: Round One
items.summary: Contestants answered questions regarding cat biology, behavior, and population statistics.

items.title: Cat Trivia: Round Two
items.summary: A new contestant joined the game as participants answered additional questions about cat breeds, lifespans, and habits.

items.title: Episode Conclusion
items.summary: The host concluded the questions and directed viewers to the following episode for the final results.
